hook: Sony released Aaron Sorkin's new feature, and it crashed with a brutal $5.5 million opening weekend.

sections.voiceover: Sony released Aaron Sorkin's new feature, and it crashed with a brutal $5.5 million opening weekend.
Sony backed The Social Reckoning as the director's massive Facebook follow-up. Friday brought in just $2.1 million including previews. Where did the $5.5 million total come from?
Universal crushed those numbers with horror instead.
Universal released Other Mommy starring Jessica Chastain. That horror hit claimed the number one box office spot with a massive $27.5 million debut.
Check the box office numbers before trusting studio forecasts.
